newsitem.title: USA: Seitel to increase 3D seismic capacity.
newsitem.headline: Seitel to increase 3D seismic capacity.

text.p: Seitel Inc said Tuesday it will add a third three-dimensional (3D) land seismic recording-crew to meet the increasing demand for 3D surveying.
"The new system and crew will effectively increase Seitel's onshore-acquisition capacity in-house by about 50 percent," said chief executive Paul A. Frame.

The company said it plans to come on line with its third telemetric seismic recording system and crew in early 1997. Presently, Seitel owns two 1850-channel telemetric systems/crews -- both fully occupied.
